convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load a custom indicator 'ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle', and depends on external library TradeAlgorithms.mqh for all trading operations (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). Custom indicator buffer logic with color-coded integer values requires reverse-engineering the custom indicator to replicate in Python.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for position open timestamps

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Buy close triggered when indicator buffer1[1]<2 (sell zone), Sell close triggered when indicator buffer1[1]>5 (buy zone)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots (0.1), BALANCE/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance, FREEMARGIN/LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin. The MM input value interpretation changes based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle indicator outputs integer color codes via buffer index 1: values >5 indicate bullish zone (blue/trend up), values <2 indicate bearish zone (red/trend down). Long entry triggers when buffer[1]>5 AND buffer[0]<6 (transition into bullish color from non-bullish). Short entry triggers when buffer[1]<2 AND buffer[0]>1 (transition into bearish color from non-bearish). This is a color-change crossover system. The signal bar defaults to bar 1 (previous completed bar). When SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated on every tick rather than only on new bars. The CIsNewBar class and LoadHistory function from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handle bar detection and history loading. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up global variables on deinit. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are computed as last bar datetime + TimeShiftSec and passed to position open functions, likely used for magic number or trade identification.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Must reverse-engineer or port the ColorSchaffRSITrendCycle custom indicator logic to Python - the buffer values are integer color codes (1-6 range) not standard oscillator values. 2) The Schaff RSI Trend Cycle is a double-smoothed stochastic applied to RSI; need to find/replicate the algorithm. 3) TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen with margin mode logic - must port all 5 margin modes (LOT, BALANCE, LOSSBALANCE, FREEMARGIN, LOSSFREEMARGIN). 4) Entry logic uses color code transitions: long when bar[1]>5 and bar[0]<6, short when bar[1]<2 and bar[0]>1 - this is a discrete state change detector on the color buffer. 5) SL/TP values (1000/2000) are in points not pips - no digit adjustment logic in the EA itself but the values are large suggesting they are already point-based. 6) SignalBar parameter allows trading on current bar (0) vs previous bar (1) - default is previous bar for confirmed signals.
